title: Observability Module Overview
summary: This module provides comprehensive tools for monitoring the application's internal state, collecting key metrics and logs. It ensures system health, performance, and facilitates rapid debugging by centralizing and routing critical operational data.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Monitoring & Logging
nodes.title: Observability Orchestrator
nodes.description: Coordinates the collection, processing, and routing of all observability data, including metrics and logs, to their respective destinations for analysis and alerting.

nodes.label: Collect System Metrics
nodes.title: System Metrics Sub-module
nodes.description: Gathers performance and health metrics from various parts of the system, such as event counts and resource utilization, for analysis by the observability core.

nodes.label: Generate Application Logs
nodes.title: Application Log Sources
nodes.description: Represents the various components within the application that generate log messages, providing detailed event information for debugging and monitoring.

nodes.label: External Monitoring Platform
nodes.title: External Monitoring Platform
nodes.description: An external system or service responsible for long-term storage, visualization, and advanced analysis of collected metrics and logs, often including dashboards and alerting.

nodes.label: Alert & Notification Service
nodes.title: Alert Notification Service
nodes.description: A dedicated service that receives alert triggers and dispatches notifications to relevant personnel or systems via various channels like email, SMS, or incident management tools.

groups.label: Core Processing
groups.title: Observability Core Processing
groups.description: The central component responsible for processing, transforming, and routing all incoming observability data to ensure it reaches the correct destinations.

groups.label: Data Sources
groups.title: Observability Data Sources
groups.description: Components and modules that generate or collect raw observability data, such as system performance metrics and application-specific log events.

groups.label: External Destinations
groups.title: External Observability Destinations
groups.description: External systems and services that consume processed observability data for storage, visualization, analysis, and dispatching alerts.
